## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? Describe the situation, not only the solution.

## Proposed change

What you'd like to happen. If it touches triage, the team presets, the ladder, the guard, or the
privacy model, say so — those areas have extra review (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why this one is better.

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, links, related issues.
